# Graphrun

> Embedded durable workflow engine for Rust. Graph is data (YAML or typed builder). Local mode is one Raft voter on a redb file in-process. No workflow server.

From the author of Workflow Core (https://github.com/danielgerlag/workflow-core).

## Install

```toml
[dependencies]
graphrun = "0.1"
```

Docs: https://docs.rs/graphrun
Repo: https://github.com/danielgerlag/graphrun
Crate: https://crates.io/crates/graphrun

## Start here

- README: https://github.com/danielgerlag/graphrun/blob/main/README.md

## Handlers

`Engine::builder(dir).activity("name", handler)?.open()`. Unregistered names fail (`activity.unregistered`). `Engine::local` enables sample fixtures only.

Do not use docs/specs/v1 as a getting-started guide.
